title: 30-Minute Beginner Upper-Body Strength Session
safety_note: Use a pain-free range of motion and stop if an exercise causes sharp pain.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Keep the torso stable and pull the handle toward the lower ribs.
exercises.modification: Reduce the resistance and use a neutral grip if needed.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Keep the shoulders down and control both phases of each repetition.
exercises.modification: Use a lighter load and stop before the elbows move behind the torso.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Pull toward the upper chest without swinging or leaning backward.
exercises.modification: Lower the weight until every repetition can be controlled.

journal_questions: Did you maintain control during every repetition?
What resistance would you keep or change next time?
